mapper.sql: d.bus_no AS record_no, d.status_enum AS status_enum, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.prescription_no, ''), r.bus_no, d.bus_no) AS prescription_no, CASE WHEN UPPER(d.dispense_enum) IN ('REFUND', 'RETURN') THEN '退药' ELSE '发药' END AS record_type_name, p.name AS patient_name, e.bus_no AS clinic_no, dept_loc.name AS dept_name, d.dispense_time, location.name AS pharmacy_name, practitioner.name AS dispenser_name, practitioner.name AS operator_account, m.name AS drug_name, m.total_volume AS spec, COALESCE(d.dispense_quantity, d.quantity) AS quantity, d.unit_code AS unit, d.lot_number AS lot_number, COALESCE(d.dosage_instruction, r.dosage_instruction) AS dosage_instruction, d.dose AS dose, d.dose_unit_code AS dose_unit_code, COALESCE(d.frequency_code, r.rate_code) AS frequency_code, m.manufacturer_text AS manufacturer_text

FROM med_medication_dispense d INNER JOIN adm_encounter e ON e.id = d.encounter_id AND e.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN adm_patient p ON p.id = d.patient_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN med_medication_request r ON r.id = d.med_req_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN med_medication_definition m ON m.id = d.medication_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_practitioner practitioner ON practitioner.id = d.practitioner_id AND practitioner.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_location dept_loc ON dept_loc.id = r.location_id AND dept_loc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_location location ON location.id = d.location_id AND location.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY d.dispense_time DESC, d.id DESC
